task: Make new init-generated local assets use Lattice names while preserving legacy Koala path compatibility for existing projects.
outcome: A user runs `lattice init --profile=codex --asset-mode=thin /tmp/demo` and sees created LATTICE.md, bin/lattice.js, bin/lattice-codex.js, .Codex/lattice.json; `find /tmp/demo -name "koala*.js" -o -name KOALA.md -o -name koala.json` prints nothing for the fresh project, while legacy projects still pass `node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex`.
facts: B-9b76 already introduced registry-backed thin prompt assets and kept full mode as compatibility default.
The source of init behavior is packages/main/src/cli-init.ts and packages/main/src/init-assets.ts in this worktree.
Codex adapter verification currently hard-codes .Codex/koala.json and bin/koala-codex.js paths.
Managed asset detection/check currently recognizes KOALA.md and Koala-named wrappers as generated assets.
constraints: Do not break existing repositories with KOALA.md, .Codex/koala.json, bin/koala.js, or bin/koala-codex.js.
Do not silently delete user-owned legacy files during init/check; only safe generated cleanup is allowed when ownership is proven.
AGENTS.md and .Codex/README.md filenames remain host adapter filenames; content can point at Lattice names.
Codex adapter changes require node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex evidence before REVIEW/DONE.
